Title: Immortal Grapple - can be used by an ally?

Messages.Author: librarian
Messages.Body:
An ally can play Immortal Grapple? (for example a Blood Brother Ambush)

> Grapple. Only usable at close range before strikes are chosen. A vampire can play only one Immortal Grapple each round.
> Strikes that are not hand strikes cannot be used this round (by either combatant).
> As above, with 1 optional press. If another round of combat occurs, that round is at close range (skip the determine range step for that round).
>
And if yes, can an ally play Immortal Grapple more than once? (for example, to cycle)

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> librarian wrote:
> An ally can play Immortal Grapple?
>
If the ally can play cards that require Potence as a vampire, yes.

> librarian wrote:
> And if yes, can an ally play Immortal Grapple more than once? (for example, to cycle)
>
No (cardtext, the ally is considered as a vampire for the matter of playing that card).

Messages.Author: Lönkka
Messages.Body:
Leech
Requires a ready mortal, ghoul, or mage.
Ⓓ Steal a blood (it becomes a life) from a vampire controlled by another Methuselah and unlock this ally. Burn any conviction cards on this ally.
This ally may play cards requiring Potence as a vampire until his or her next unlock phase.

I have a deck that enables a certain Mr Muddles use Immortal Grapples via Leech since a cross table ally is often quite ready to donate one blood on one of their vamps to fuel Mr Muddles' rampage on a naughty common foe.

Finnish  Politics!
